notes.title: Fan disc "The Town of Nie Iromusubi" store page now available
notes.notes:
A fan-disc of the strange and eerie otherworldly BL fantasy "The Town of Nie" (released September 2024 on Nintendo Switch) is now available for the Nintendo Switch and on Steam!

This title is set about one year after the main story, and features epilogues for the lover partners, side stories told from the perspective of side characters, and episodes after the ending, which delves deeper into the characters and the world view.
